fact: The document says the Direction generale du Budget (Ministry of Economy and Finance) runs a public, unauthenticated open-data API at opendata.budgetbenin.bj serving budget classification data (113 aggregates, held extract 5,351 rows across seven datasets, covering 2008-2024 and some 2025); the date is the document's published date, 2026-07-25, when it was retrieved.
